segments.name: banking
segments.description: Community bank providing commercial and consumer banking, lending, treasury management, trust and wealth management services to individuals and businesses in Maryland, Delaware and Virginia.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company had one operating segment, the banking segment.

revenueModel.text: Individuals, businesses and organizations pay the Bank for deposit accounts, loans, treasury management, trust and wealth management services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank provides consumer and commercial banking products and services and secondary mortgage lending, trust, wealth management and financial planning services.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company discontinued real estate closing and title services as its title insurance subsidiary ceased conducting real estate closings.
changes.evidence: The Title Company ceased conducting real estate closings effective March 31, 2025.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company discontinued issuing new marine loans and only services the existing portfolio.
changes.evidence: The Company discontinued the issuance of new marine loans in June 2023 and only services the existing portfolio as of December 31, 2025.
